articles.title: How confident are you that Cameron Carr can make an immediate impact as a rookie?
articles.original_title: How confident are you that Cameron Carr can make an immediate impact as a rookie?
articles.summary: Carr looked really promising in Summer League. The shooting showed flashes, but what stood out more was his defense, length and athleticism. Compared to Knecht coming in, Carr’s archetype feels more NBA-ready. He doesn’t need the ball or have to score to be useful. If he can defend, hit open 3s and play within the offense, there’s a pretty clear role for him. Summer League is Summer League, but are you confident Carr can actually crack the rotation early?    submitted by    /u/deno
